subject: words
title: Y says ee: happy
about: At the end of a two-syllable word, y says ee (happy, puppy), unlike the short words in the level before where y says i. CKLA Grade 1 does not teach this (it is Grade 2 code), so this is a step-ahead level for late spring; every word here has two syllables, each with its own vowel sound, which is the rule NC RF.1.4.d builds on (also RF.1.4.c).
tip: Clap the two parts first (hap-py), then remind him that a y at the very end of a long word says ee.
